does.evidence: EoCServer.dll Update (87 lines) read; the source file named in its assert is ThrowSystem.cpp.

does.text: Goes through entities that just received esv::thrown::EntityThrownRequestOneFrameComponent (an added-component query; its log text is 'Requested throwing of %s'). For each it adds eoc::thrown::IsThrownComponent when the entity lacks the query's first optional component and a float of the request is non-zero, and adds eoc::thrown::ThrownAnimationRequestOneFrameComponent when the entity has the query's second optional component; both new components receive that float. The tests are on the query's component slots, not on members of the request, and which two components those slots are was not identified (the query reads Character, esv::Character, esv::Projectile and ls::DebugComponent besides the request).
